transcript.text: Seeing that the Theroy Kapoor only is your main style, I guess I found mine too. But everyday plans are like my duty to keep up with the outfit. A few pieces, I'll just start in Hanang. But when I'm meeting people or actually making an effort, I like mixing different designs to make them look feel a little more me. And when it's time to really dress up, more layers, more designs, that's the move. Different plans, different looks, Jeeva, just got me covered.
